evidence.observedFact: The business operates by appointment only, requires a valid credit card on file or pre-payment to schedule, may request 50% up front as a booking fee, and states that late cancellation, rescheduling, sickness, lateness or no-show within 48 hours may trigger a booking fee.

The public booking profile states that customers using prepaid services or gift cards should call or text directly to schedule; online bookings may require a non-refundable 50% booking retainer, and cancellations or no-shows within 48 hours can be charged up to 100% of the booked service.
The business publishes extended hours for groups or events, indicating that group/event bookings are an active part of the service model.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate automated confirmation, reminder, reschedule recovery and prepaid/gift-card follow-up flows around appointment bookings.
Capture group attendees into a permission-based return-visit reward sequence after events or group services.
Use prepaid-service and gift-card reminders as a reactivation path for customers who have value on file but have not yet scheduled.

recommendedEntryOffer: Appointment Recovery + Prepaid Reactivation Revenue Engine
notes: Observed facts show strict booking rules, prepaid/gift-card scheduling friction and group/event activity. Hypothesis: automated reminders and reactivation can improve booking completion and repeat usage. No monetary loss is claimed from public evidence.
